products.title: GoldPlus GP-C12 GaN USB-C Fast Charger with USB-C to Lightning Cable (UK plug)
products.shortDescription: GaN USB-C charger with a braided USB-C to Lightning cable in the box. Marked 50W; its printed outputs give about 20W, iPhone fast-charge speed. UK plug.
products.longDescription: A GaN wall charger with a single USB-C port and a UK 3-pin plug, sold as a kit with a braided USB-C to Lightning cable for iPhone. The box marks it 50W, but the maker's own output ratings are 5V⎓3A, 9V⎓2.2A and 12V⎓1.6A, which work out to about 20W at most, so we list it as a 20W charger: the speed an iPhone fast-charges at, not a laptop charger. Temperature, overcurrent and short-circuit protection in an ABS body. Every unit is tested before it is sold; same-day delivery in Kampala and Wakiso.
